desc:
💀 Welcome to +1 Reaper Evolution!

⚔️ Swing your scythe to gain Power!
👻 Defeat enemies and harvest souls!
🖤 Evolve into powerful Reapers with new scythes, hoods, and capes!
✨ Unlock deadly abilities and equip your favorite two!
🐾 Hatch pets to boost your progress!
🌎 Conquer three worlds filled with tougher enemies!
🔄 Rebirth, grow stronger, and become the ultimate Grim Reaper!
